Ba Advanced Settings Resource Get Custom File Hash Quota
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/behavioralAnalysisAdvancedSettings/fileHashCount

Gets the used and unused quota for blocking MD5 file hashes with Sandbox

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
blockedFileHashesCount
int32

The number of unique MD5 file hashes that are blocked by Sandbox.

remainingFileHashes
int32

Unused quota for blocking MD5 file hashes.
